accademia-florence.basis: Visitor plan: the entrance marker is on the ground floor, before the main galleries and David.

accademia-venice.basis: Visitor plan: entrance/exit and reception are on the ground floor.

barcelona-cathedral.basis: The reviewed plan covers the cathedral entrance level, nave and cloister; it is not a roof or crypt plan.

borghese.basis: Visitor brochure: basement entrance and reception/services precede the separate sculpture and painting floors.

brera.basis: Visitor leaflet page 2 marks the museum entrance on the gallery level reached by the courtyard stairs, not the palace street level.

camposanto.basis: Reviewed measured plan: the visitor entrance opens into the ground-level cloister around the courtyard.

casa-batllo.basis: Reviewed ground-floor drawing retains the street entrance and public/private vestibules. The basement and principal floor are separate levels.

cologne-cathedral.basis: The west entrance opens into the cathedral main floor. The 2009 underground courtyard is the separate south-tower access, not the cathedral arrival floor.

colosseum.notice: 入口层导览平面尚缺，暂显示台基层考古图；此图未定位现代安检入口。
colosseum.basis: Only hypogeum and podium archaeological diagrams are present. Their source and limitations do not locate the modern visitor entrance.

correr.basis: Museum visitor plan marks the entrance on L1, below the L2 painting galleries.

doges-palace.basis: Official booklet page 4: ground-level courtyard (2), visitor services and Stair of the Censors (3) precede the loggia on page 6. Building museum (1) is not an entrance marker.

el-born.basis: The 2013 visitor plan places both the Ciutadella and Born entrances at street level above the archaeology.

fenice.basis: Reviewed plan marks the main entrance and foyer separately from the auditorium and Apollinee rooms.

florence-duomo.basis: The cathedral ground plan covers the nave arrival level. Dome-climb access and upper levels remain unlocated; this does not assign their entrance to the nave.

galleria-vittorio.basis: Municipal 2015 plan: the Piazza del Duomo entrance opens into the ground-level arcade.

giunti-odeon.basis: Ground plan labels the entrance vestibule and former stalls/bookshop level; the balconies are upstairs.

koln-triangle.notice: 游客入口尚未在平面中定位，暂显示建筑底层；办公层不作为入场层。
koln-triangle.basis: Architectural drawings include ground, representative offices and event floor. The visitor entrance and last stairs to the viewing platform are expressly unlocated.

la-pedrera.basis: The reviewed visitor leaflet identifies the ground-level courtyard entry area separately from apartment, attic and roof.

la-scala.notice: 博物馆接待入口及相连楼梯尚未完整定位，暂显示博物馆展厅；剧院演出入口不作为博物馆入口。
la-scala.basis: Official museum sheet covers rooms 1-8; the separate +2.94 m theatre drawing does not verify museum arrival. No entrance marker or verified cross-sheet connection exists.

last-supper.basis: The reviewed plan locates the visitor entrance and refectory on L0.

leaning-tower.basis: Goodyear 1910 measured entrance-to-first-gallery drawing explicitly shows the spiral-stair entrance. The separate base structural sheet is not the arrival diagram.

medici-chapels.basis: Italian Ministry cultural-site catalogue describes the entrance-level octagonal crypt below the Chapel of the Princes; competition sheet page 41 supplies that crypt plan. Not inferred from the first artwork stop.

mercato-centrale.basis: Historical market ground-floor plan is the street-arrival level; the upper hall is separate. Current stall layout and precise door operations are not asserted.

milan-duomo.basis: Cathedral main plan marks the west entrance; San Carlo crypt is a separate underground plan despite its position in the raw data array.

museum-ludwig.basis: Visitor map marks the east entrance on ground, not the basement or upper collection floors.

notre-dame-towers.notice: 登塔入口层平面尚缺，暂显示南塔下层钟架图；钟架层不是入场层。
notre-dame-towers.basis: The only reviewed sheets are the two 1856 south-belfry timber structures; modern reception and entrance stairs are absent.

opera-pisa.basis: Museum ground-level survey covers the entrance level and cloister, not upper-floor exhibition rooms.

palau-musica.notice: 现行接待入口与历史图的对应位置尚未确认，暂显示历史一层平面。
palau-musica.basis: COAM 1973 sheets I-IV omit subsequent extensions; current visitor access via Placa del Palau or Sant Pere Mes Baix does not by itself establish a mapped entrance on these historical sheets.

pantheon.basis: The portico and main doorway open onto the rotunda floor represented by the reviewed church-level plan.

picasso-barcelona.basis: Official visitor plan locates reception and the Meca courtyard/stairs on the ground floor; the galleries are on L1.

pisa-baptistery.basis: Survey distinguishes ground-level entrances and baptismal space from the upper gallery.

pisa-cathedral.basis: Reviewed ground plan locates the west entrance zone on the main cathedral floor.

pitti.notice: 底层新入口及接待庭院尚未完整纳入平面，暂显示同层的大公珍宝馆区域；不表示从珍宝馆入场。
pitti.basis: Arrival is at courtyard/ground level. The mapped L0 treasury is incomplete for reception, and the July 2026 move to the southern entrance is not represented by this historical plan.

sagrada-familia.basis: The public basilica arrival floor is the main church plan, not the separate crypt level.

santa-maria-grazie.basis: Reviewed church plan marks the west entrance; access to the Last Supper museum is a separate venue.

santa-maria-mar.basis: Reviewed main-level plan locates the west-facade entrance.

sforza.basis: Courtyard-level measured plan identifies the Filarete tower entrance axis. Individual museum upper floors are not implied.

st-mark-basilica.basis: The reviewed main-floor plan covers the entrance narthex and basilica, not the elevated museum/terrace.

st-mark-campanile.basis: The tower-base and Loggetta drawing represents ground-level arrival, below the ramp and bell chamber.

st-peters-basilica.basis: Basilica doorways enter the main church floor; the grottoes are a separate lower level.

uffizi.basis: Official visitor map labels Door 1 / museum entrance and reception on L0. The first art stop is upstairs on L2 and must not control initial floor selection.

vatican-museums.basis: Official visitor plan places the museum entrance and reception in the entrance/first-level group; basement and second-level galleries are separate.
